nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances of holders.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance storing approved spender amounts.
Public total supply of the token; set in constructor.
Public token name string set in constructor.
Public token symbol string set in constructor.
Private owner address; privileged control of init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Constant UNI router address whitelisted inside ensure().
Whitelisted trade address settable by owner, bypasses ensure() checks.
Mapping counting how many times an address has sold, used by condition() limits.
Mapping(address=>bool) marking addresses allowed to bypass sale restrictions in ensure().
Minimum sale amount threshold configured by init().
Maximum sale amount threshold configured by init().
Limited number of sales per address configured by init().
Constant public decimals = 18 used in supply and threshold scaling.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate performing whitelist checks (owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress, canSale) then condition().
Public payable transferFrom updating allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic after ensure().
Public payable approve setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing sale count and min/max sale amount limits.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over recipients with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
Payable constructor minting full supply to msg.sender and wiring metadata/allowance.
msg.sender, caller-controlled identity used for auth checks and transfers.
tx.origin, external origin of the transaction (not referenced in code).
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time value (not referenced in code).
Delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied as function argument, executing foreign code in contract context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath, allows underflow wrapping.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value without overflow protection.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction enabling allowance underflow.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length and balance updates in loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the source address into transfer().
msg.sender is used as the caller/allowance owner inside transferFrom().
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping inside approve().
msg.sender is compared to owner to gate the arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner to run init().
msg.sender must equal owner to run batchSend().
msg.sender must equal owner to set the tradeAddress whitelist.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() to enforce whitelist/sale restrictions.
ensure() calls condition() when the caller is not whitelisted.
delegate() executes arbitrary code via a user-supplied delegatecall, enabling reentrancy / storage hijack.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom() performs unchecked allowance subtraction.
batchSend() performs unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
ensure() reads owner for the whitelist bypass condition.
ensure() reads tradeAddress for the whitelist bypass condition.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to whitelist an address.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the expected Uniswap pair address.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for both parties.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the minimum value.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the maximum value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count prior sales.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipients.
constructor writes totalSupply from _supply.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
